text: A tender package, including all technical requirements, material, and labour, was prepared by McIntosh Perry Limited as previously approved by the TPA (Internal Memorandum, November 7, 2017). McIntosh Perry Limited tendered the work on behalf of the TPA to 11 pre-qualified general contractors on May 1, 2019. The call closed on May 22, 2019 and four bids were received and considered as listed below in the ascending order without the HST. Table 1: Summary of Bids Received (net of applicable taxes) General Contractors Amount Percentage Alto Restoration Ltd. $555,200 100 CanMar Contracting Ltd. $597,300 108 Structural Contracting Ltd. $641,550 116 Martinway Contracting Ltd. $1,018,000 183

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Granted authority to award the construction contract for the modifications to operations at Municipal Car Park 58, located at 9 Bedford Road, to Alto Restoration Inc., having submitted the lowest compliant bid and meeting all specifications in conformance with the tender requirements, in the amount of $555,200 plus $54,800 as a contingency allowance, being the sum total amount of $610,000 net of all taxes and charges.
